Kiro tutorial for beginners: install and build your first project in 6 steps

Six steps to install Kiro and build your first project.

1. Download Kiro
2. Sign in
3. Open a folder
4. Describe your idea
5. Review the spec
6. Run the tasks

Know a dev who needs this? Send it to them.
